notes.title: Versio 1.0 - Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hi!

We’re excited to see you here! The game is finally finished, and we’ve added some exciting updates!

[b]New Art![/b]:
A brand new duo artwork featuring Miya and Aya together has been added to the gallery! Complete the puzzle to unlock this beautiful moment.

[b]Achievements[/b]:
Simply launch the game, and any achievements you earned during the beta will automatically sync with Steam.
New players can enjoy unlocking them all during gameplay!

Enjoy the updated version, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: ✨ New Art: Romance of Mya and Aya in the Gallery! 💕
notes.notes:
In this update, we've added a brand-new illustration featuring Mya and Aya!
Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tenderness and magic — unlock the new image by completing fresh puzzle levels.

Follow the story of our beloved catgirls, brought together by ancient magic...
Each puzzle is a step closer to uncovering their warm and heartfelt love.
